semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: A formal communication or directive issued under the contract, specifically referenced in the context of Sub-Clause 15.2.1 and Sub-Clause 16.2.1 regarding response times and suspension of work.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The term 'Notice' appears as a header or key label within table rows defining specific sub-clause modifications (15.2.1 and 16.2.1). It serves as a structural anchor for contractual obligations related to formal notifications.
